description: Frame-robustness of the μ₃ (A=3 magnitude) target. μ₃ = ρ_strong(3) − ρ_grad(3) is a small residual (≈0.47) that is a difference of two O(3.5) numbers, so — like g₂=1+r — it inherits an ≈7× amplified sensitivity to the subtracted baseline. Measured across three legitimate deuteron-normalized A-scaling baselines (graded coinvariant dimension = CORPUS #4300, balanced quantum dimension, classical q→1) the SIGNS (μ₃>0, μ₄<0) are robust but μ₃'s MAGNITUDE swings by a factor comparable to / exceeding the 1.6× gap the closure attempts target. Hence the '1.6× A=3 magnitude gap' is baseline-CLASS-relative, not absolute. scope-(a) CAVEAT (not a refutation of the principled graded-dimension route): closure attempts must state their baseline. Anti-fit STRICT; nothing wired; exact (mpmath).
tier: scope-(a) frame-robustness measurement (baseline-class spread of the μ₃ target); no fit; nothing wired

frame_independent_full_ratio.reading: the '1.6× gap on μ₃' (model reaches 0.63·μ₃) is the SAME absolute miss Δ as a ~4.6% shortfall on the physical ratio B(³H)/B(²H); the residual framing amplifies Δ by ρ_strong(3)/μ₃ ≈ 8×. The frame-INDEPENDENT accuracy statement is the % on the physical ratio, not the multiplicative gap on the small residual.

verdict.classification: scope-(a) CAVEAT (not a refutation): μ₃ (hence the '1.6× A=3 magnitude gap') is baseline-CLASS-relative. The SIGNS (μ₃>0, μ₄<0) are robust across the graded / quantum / classical A-scalings, but the MAGNITUDE μ₃ swings by the reported spread factor — comparable to or exceeding the 1.6× gap itself. Because μ₃ = ρ_strong(3) − ρ_grad(3) is a small difference of two O(3.5) numbers, it inherits an ≈7× amplified sensitivity to the subtracted baseline (the same fragility as g₂=1+r). The corpus baseline (G) is the more-motivated one (it IS the graded coinvariant dimension, #4300), so this does NOT refute the (G) route — it flags that closure attempts must state they close the gap to the graded-dimension-referenced μ₃; a reviewer picking the quantum-dimension (Q) reference sees a different gap.
verdict.anti_fit: ρ_strong / c₃ / AME / CODATA consumed only as fixed targets; no q, no baseline inverted. μ₂=0 (deuteron self-ref) preserved by every baseline. Nothing wired.
